display.purpose: One landing-page promise or major product moment.

body.purpose: Explanatory content capped near 70 characters per line.

numeric.purpose: Timers, amounts, quantities, and comparative metrics.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and sheets when tonal separation is insufficient.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: Optional transform-and-opacity entrances with a reduced-motion fallback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a product screen or marketing section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--primary, #faff69); color: var(--primary-foreground, #0a0a0a); font: 500 14px/1.4 Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-active, #e6eb52); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #faff69); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action that remains easy to discover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--card, #1a1a1a); color: var(--foreground, #f7f6ef); font: 500 14px/1.4 Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--card-elevated, #242424); border-color: var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #faff69); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A clearly labeled field for forms and filters.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--foreground, #f7f6ef); font-family: Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-input { min-height: 40px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); border-radius: var(--radius, 8px); background: var(--card, #1a1a1a); color: inherit; font: 400 16px/1.5 Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #faff69); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--primary, #faff69); }

components.name: Ledger Card
components.description: A flat grouped surface for a financial or workflow unit.
components.css: .ds-ledger-card { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); border-radius: var(--radius-card, 12px); background: var(--card, #1a1a1a); color: var(--foreground, #f7f6ef); } .ds-ledger-label { color: var(--muted-foreground, #888888); font: 500 14px/1.4 Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-ledger-value { font: 600 24px/1.2 JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-card:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, #3a3a3a); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A text-plus-color state marker for paid, active, or incomplete records.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: max-content; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--success, #22c55e) 14%, transparent); color: var(--success, #22c55e); font: 500 13px/1.3 Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: currentColor; }

components.name: Marketing Navigation
components.description: A compact floating rail for the public site.
components.html: ClockBillאיך זה עובדהתחל בחינם
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 10px 12px 10px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a2a2a); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--background, #0a0a0a); color: var(--foreground, #f7f6ef); font: 500 14px/1.4 Heebo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgba(0,0,0,.1); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--primary, #faff69); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #faff69); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-cta { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #faff69); color: var(--primary-foreground, #0a0a0a) !important; }

narrative.overview: ClockBill should feel like a ledger that fills itself while the freelancer works. Every timer, item, task, document, and payment belongs to one continuous money trail. The experience is fast and exact, but the interface welcomes the user before asking them to make financial decisions.
keyCharacteristics: Work flows visibly toward a financial outcome.
Dense data stays legible; explanatory content gets more breathing room.
Hebrew RTL and English LTR are equal first-class layouts.
Color is semantic and restrained; numeric typography signals precision.
Interaction is immediate, predictable, and recoverable.

rules.name: The Money Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent color marks an action, focus target, or financial state. It never decorates a sentence or fills an entire section without meaning.

rules.name: The Hebrew Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Hebrew uses normal letter spacing, generous line height, and visual hierarchy from size and weight. Never add tracking to Hebrew display or body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A shadow must explain layer ownership or temporary elevation. It is never a decorative glow around a static card.

dos: Do connect each feature explanation to a user outcome and a financial consequence.
Do use semantic tokens so every component works across all 12 themes.
Do keep body copy near 70 characters per line and use 1.6 line height for explanations.
Do provide loading, success, error, and empty states for every product screen.
Do honor RTL behavior, reduced motion, keyboard navigation, 200% zoom, and 44px touch targets.
Do isolate amounts, times, identifiers, and mixed-direction strings with <bdi> or an equivalent bidi-safe treatment.
donts: Don't recreate the coldness of a developer infrastructure dashboard.
Don't import the density and anxiety of enterprise finance software.
Don't build generic SaaS marketing from vague claims, decorative gradients, or interchangeable feature-card grids.
Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism as decoration, nested cards, or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't turn every metric into a hero card or use accent color without semantic meaning.
Don't animate layout properties, use transition: all, or require motion to understand state.
Don't hardcode physical left/right layout properties where logical RTL/LTR properties work.
